# Contributing

Bug reports, layout fixes and pull requests are welcome.

## Setup

- Python 3.11+ and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)
- A C compiler (for the native tests)
- For the Flipper app: `uvx ufbt` downloads the SDK and toolchain on first use

```bash
make test      # companion tests and native crypto core
make fap       # build flipper/vaultflipper/dist/vaultflipper.fap
make launch    # install and start on a connected Flipper
```

## Guidelines

- Keep `vf_core.c` free of Flipper APIs so it keeps building natively.
- A change to the file format needs a new version byte and tests on both sides.
- User-facing text: English source plus German translation – `vf_i18n.h` on the Flipper, `i18n.py` in the companion. The tests fail if a translation is missing.
- Add a line to `CHANGELOG.md` under *Unreleased*, in plain words for users.

## Keyboard layouts

Layouts are 256-byte BadUSB `.kl` files. Mac variants are generated by `tools/make_mac_layouts.py`; add a table there for a new language and put the result in `flipper/vaultflipper/files/layouts/`. Check it with `vaultflipper typetest`.

## Icons

The 10×10 icons are pixel art in `tools/make_icons.py`; run it to regenerate `flipper/vaultflipper/images/`.

## Testing on hardware

`tools/flipctl.py` drives the Flipper over USB and takes screenshots (`make protos` once). It only sends keys while the VaultFlipper title bar is on screen, so presses never land on the Flipper desktop. For remote tests build with `cdefines=["VF_TEST_NO_HID"]` in `application.fam`: that build never types and opens `test.vfv` instead of your real `vault.vfv` (write one with `vaultflipper build … --out` and copy it there). Remove the line again before committing.
